paragraphs.text: translated by
1. As 'twere with swift exertion of the spirit, let the priest speed to the celestial Waters,
paragraphs.original: प्र देवत्रा ब्रह्मणे गातुरेत्वपो अच्छा मनसो न प्रयुक्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: pra devatrā brahmaṇe gāturetvapo acchā manaso na prayukti |

paragraphs.text: The glorious food of Varuna and Mitra. To him who spreadeth far this laud I offer.
paragraphs.original: महीं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धासिं पृथुज्रयसे रीरधा सुवृक्तिम्
paragraphs.translit: mahīṃ mitrasya varuṇasya dhāsiṃ pṛthujrayase rīradhā suvṛktim

paragraphs.text: 2. Adhvaryus, he ye ready with oblations,, and come with longing to the longing Waters,
paragraphs.original: अध्वर्यवो हविष्मन्तो हि भूताच्छाप इतोशतीरुशन्तः ।
paragraphs.translit: adhvaryavo haviṣmanto hi bhūtācchāpa itośatīruśantaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Down on which looks the. purple-tinted Eagle. Pour ye that flowing wave this day, deft-handed.
paragraphs.original: अव याश्चष्टे अरुणः सुपर्णस्तमास्यध्वमूर्मिमद्या सुहस्ताः
paragraphs.translit: ava yāścaṣṭe aruṇaḥ suparṇastamāsyadhvamūrmimadyā suhastāḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Go to the reservoir, O ye Adhvaryus worship the Waters' Child with your oblations.
paragraphs.original: अध्वर्यवोऽप इता समुद्रमपां नपातं हविषा यजध्वम् ।
paragraphs.translit: adhvaryavo'pa itā samudramapāṃ napātaṃ haviṣā yajadhvam |

paragraphs.text: A consecrated wave he now will give you, so press for him the Soma rich in sweetness.
paragraphs.original: स वो दददूर्मिमद्या सुपूतं तस्मै सोमं मधुमन्तं सुनोत
paragraphs.translit: sa vo dadadūrmimadyā supūtaṃ tasmai somaṃ madhumantaṃ sunota

paragraphs.text: 4. He who shines bright in floods, unfed with fuel, whom sages worship at their sacrifices:
paragraphs.original: यो अनिध्मो दीदयदप्स्वन्तर्यं विप्रास ईळते अध्वरेषु ।
paragraphs.translit: yo anidhmo dīdayadapsvantaryaṃ viprāsa īḷate adhvareṣu |

paragraphs.text: Give waters rich in sweets, Child of the Waters, even those which gave heroic might to Indra:
paragraphs.original: अपां नपान्मधुमतीरपो दा याभिरिन्द्रो वावृधे वीर्याय
paragraphs.translit: apāṃ napānmadhumatīrapo dā yābhirindro vāvṛdhe vīryāya

paragraphs.text: 5. Those in which Soma joys and is delighted, as a young man with fair and pleasant damsels.
paragraphs.original: याभिः सोमो मोदते हर्षते च कल्याणीभिर्युवतिभिर्न मर्यः ।
paragraphs.translit: yābhiḥ somo modate harṣate ca kalyāṇībhiryuvatibhirna maryaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Go thou unto those Waters, O Adhvaryu, and purify with herbs what thou infusest.
paragraphs.original: ता अध्वर्यो अपो अच्छा परेहि यदासिञ्चा ओषधीभिः पुनीतात्
paragraphs.translit: tā adhvaryo apo acchā parehi yadāsiñcā oṣadhībhiḥ punītāt

paragraphs.text: 6. So maidens bow before the youthful gallant who comes with love to them who yearn to meet him.
paragraphs.original: एवेद्यूने युवतयो नमन्त यदीमुशन्नुशतीरेत्यच्छ ।
paragraphs.translit: evedyūne yuvatayo namanta yadīmuśannuśatīretyaccha |

paragraphs.text: In heart accordant and in wish one-minded are the Adhvaryus and the heavenly Waters.
paragraphs.original: सं जानते मनसा सं चिकित्रेऽध्वर्यवो धिषणापश्च देवीः
paragraphs.translit: saṃ jānate manasā saṃ cikitre'dhvaryavo dhiṣaṇāpaśca devīḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. He who made room for you when fast imprisoned, who freed you from the mighty imprecation,-
paragraphs.original: यो वो वृताभ्यो अकृणोदु लोकं यो वो मह्या अभिशस्तेरमुञ्चत् ।
paragraphs.translit: yo vo vṛtābhyo akṛṇodu lokaṃ yo vo mahyā abhiśasteramuñcat |

paragraphs.text: Even to that Indra send the meath-rich current, the wave that gratifies the Gods, O Waters.
paragraphs.original: तस्मा इन्द्राय मधुमन्तमूर्मिं देवमादनं प्र हिणोतनापः
paragraphs.translit: tasmā indrāya madhumantamūrmiṃ devamādanaṃ pra hiṇotanāpaḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. Send forth to him the meath-rich wave, O Rivers, which is your offspring and a well of sweetness,
paragraphs.original: प्रास्मै हिनोत मधुमन्तमूर्मिं गर्भो यो वः सिन्धवो मध्व उत्सः ।
paragraphs.translit: prāsmai hinota madhumantamūrmiṃ garbho yo vaḥ sindhavo madhva utsaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Oil-balmed, to be implored at sacrifices. Ye wealthy Waters, hear mine invocation.
paragraphs.original: घृतपृष्ठमीड्यमध्वरेष्वापो रेवतीः शृणुता हवं मे
paragraphs.translit: ghṛtapṛṣṭhamīḍyamadhvareṣvāpo revatīḥ śṛṇutā havaṃ me

paragraphs.text: 9. Send forth the rapture-giving wave, O Rivers, which Indra drinks, which sets the Twain in motion;
paragraphs.original: तं सिन्धवो मत्सरमिन्द्रपानमूर्मिं प्र हेत य उभे इयर्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: taṃ sindhavo matsaramindrapānamūrmiṃ pra heta ya ubhe iyarti |

paragraphs.text: The well that springeth from the clouds, desirous, that wandereth triple-formed, distilling transport.
paragraphs.original: मदच्युतमौशानं नभोजां परि त्रितन्तुं विचरन्तमुत्सम्
paragraphs.translit: madacyutamauśānaṃ nabhojāṃ pari tritantuṃ vicarantamutsam

paragraphs.text: 10. These winding Streams which with their double current, like cattle-raiders, seek the lower pastures,-
paragraphs.original: आवर्वृततीरध नु द्विधारा गोषुयुधो न नियवं चरन्तीः ।
paragraphs.translit: āvarvṛtatīradha nu dvidhārā goṣuyudho na niyavaṃ carantīḥ |

paragraphs.text: Waters which dwell together, thrive together, Queens, Mothers of the world, these, Rsi, honour.
paragraphs.original: ऋषे जनित्रीर्भुवनस्य पत्नीरपो वन्दस्व सवृधः सयोनीः
paragraphs.translit: ṛṣe janitrīrbhuvanasya patnīrapo vandasva savṛdhaḥ sayonīḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. Send forth our sacrifice with holy worship send forth the hymn and prayer for gain of riches.
paragraphs.original: हिनोता नो अध्वरं देवयज्या हिनोत ब्रह्म सनये धनानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: hinotā no adhvaraṃ devayajyā hinota brahma sanaye dhanānām |

paragraphs.text: For need of sacrifice disclose the udder. Give gracious hearing to our call, O Waters.
paragraphs.original: ऋतस्य योगे वि ष्यध्वमूधः श्रुष्टीवरीर्भूतनास्मभ्यमापः
paragraphs.translit: ṛtasya yoge vi ṣyadhvamūdhaḥ śruṣṭīvarīrbhūtanāsmabhyamāpaḥ

paragraphs.text: 12. For, wealthy Waters, ye control all treasures: ye bring auspicious intellect and Amrta.
paragraphs.original: आपो रेवतीः क्षयथा हि वस्वः क्रतुं च भद्रं बिभृथामृतं च ।
paragraphs.translit: āpo revatīḥ kṣayathā hi vasvaḥ kratuṃ ca bhadraṃ bibhṛthāmṛtaṃ ca |

paragraphs.text: Ye are the Queens of independent riches Sarasvati give full life to the singer!
paragraphs.original: रायश्च स्थ स्वपत्यस्य पत्नीः सरस्वती तद्गृणते वयो धात्
paragraphs.translit: rāyaśca stha svapatyasya patnīḥ sarasvatī tadgṛṇate vayo dhāt

paragraphs.text: 13. When I behold the Waters coming hither, carrying with them milk and meath and butter,
paragraphs.original: प्रति यदापो अदृश्रमायतीर्घृतं पयांसि बिभ्रतीर्मधूनि ।
paragraphs.translit: prati yadāpo adṛśramāyatīrghṛtaṃ payāṃsi bibhratīrmadhūni |

paragraphs.text: Bearing the well-pressed Soma juice to Indra, they harmonize in spirit with Adhvaryus.
paragraphs.original: अध्वर्युभिर्मनसा संविदाना इन्द्राय सोमं सुषुतं भरन्तीः
paragraphs.translit: adhvaryubhirmanasā saṃvidānā indrāya somaṃ suṣutaṃ bharantīḥ

paragraphs.text: 14. Rich, they are come with wealth for living beings, O friends, Adhvaryus, seat them in their places.
paragraphs.original: एमा अग्मन्रेवतीर्जीवधन्या अध्वर्यवः सादयता सखायः ।
paragraphs.translit: emā agmanrevatīrjīvadhanyā adhvaryavaḥ sādayatā sakhāyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Seat them on holy grass, ye Soma-bringers in harmony with the Offspring of the Waters.
paragraphs.original: नि बर्हिषि धत्तन सोम्यासोऽपां नप्त्रा संविदानास एनाः
paragraphs.translit: ni barhiṣi dhattana somyāso'pāṃ naptrā saṃvidānāsa enāḥ

paragraphs.text: 15. Now to this grass are come the longing Waters: the Pious Ones are seated at our worship.
paragraphs.original: आग्मन्नाप उशतीर्बर्हिरेदं न्यध्वरे असदन्देवयन्तीः ।
paragraphs.translit: āgmannāpa uśatīrbarhiredaṃ nyadhvare asadandevayantīḥ |

paragraphs.text: Adhvaryus, press the Soma juice for Indra so will the service of the Gods be easy.
paragraphs.original: अध्वर्यवः सुनुतेन्द्राय सोममभूदु वः सुशका देवयज्या
paragraphs.translit: adhvaryavaḥ sunutendrāya somamabhūdu vaḥ suśakā devayajyā
